.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r13/task/solution/app/package.json, vite.config.mjs, index.html, public/index.html, public/runner.html, static/runner.html, public/assets/index.js (grep), public/assets/index.css, src/app.tsx and src/runtime.ts (grep)
evidence:
solve.sh (solution/solve.sh): '#!/bin/bash' line 1, 'set -euo pipefail' line 2, no CR bytes (grep -c CR = 0), 'bash -n' succeeds. Its only writes are 'mkdir -p "$target"' with target=/app (lines 4-5), 'rm -f -- "$target/app.db" "$target/app.db-wal" "$target/app.db-shm"' (line 38) and 'cp -a "$source_app/." "$target/"' (line 39); nothing targets /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution; no pkill, no NODE_ENV, no npm/pip install, no network fetch. source_app is resolved from $0 (line 6) so it works from any cwd, and 'test -f "$source_app/server.js"' fails loudly on a missing payload. The payload contains server.js at its root, which is what tests/test.sh requires ('if [[ ! -f /app/server.js ]]' line 68) and launches ('node "$APP_ENTRY"' line 111). No symlinks and no *.db files exist under solution/ (find), so the test.sh symlink refusal (lines 72-83) cannot trigger and no stale database ships.

Runtime contract in server.js: 'const root = __dirname;' (line 7) with static files and index served from path.join(root, 'public') (lines 130-131), so cwd outside /app and the /tmp/submission fallback copy both resolve; 'const databasePath = process.env.DB_PATH || process.env.SQLITE_PATH || path.join(root, 'app.db');' (line 8) honours DB_PATH and defaults to /app/app.db as integration.md states; 'app.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0', ...)' (line 142); 'app.get('/api/health', ...)' (line 12) is registered before the database guard so the liveness probe answers at once. Schema creation is 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS' plus 'INSERT OR IGNORE' (lines 147-168) and there is no seed insert, so start-up is idempotent across restarts. The only bare requires are express and better-sqlite3 (lines 4-5); both are installed globally at the same pinned versions in environment/Dockerfile (lines 9-11) and tests/Dockerfile (lines 16-21) and reached through NODE_PATH, which test.sh passes under env -i (line 106). No node_modules is shipped or needed.

Self-contained frontend: public/index.html references only /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css; the committed bundle (1,915,401 bytes) has no dynamic import or external module specifier, and the only absolute URLs in it are XML namespaces and documentation strings inside bundled libraries. runtime.ts line 390 loads '/runner.html', which is present in public/. Opening the app needs no build or install, as integration.md requires. The bundle is current: results/build.log shows vite producing index.js 1,915.40 kB and index.css 10.66 kB, matching the frozen file sizes, with file times 19:29:09 just after the src files (19:28:53); public/assets/index.css is byte-identical to src/style.css and public/runner.html to static/runner.html (cmp).

Measured run on these bytes: 'diff -rq' of the frozen task against projects/colderwater-playground-devtools reports no difference, and every artifact hash in raw-evidence-index.json observation 1 re-computed equal (sha256sum). run_golden.sh installs with 'docker exec "$name" bash /solution/solve.sh' (line 23) into the agent image and launches with 'cd /tmp && exec setsid env -i PATH=... NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules HOME=/app PORT=3000 DB_PATH=/app/app.db setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups node /app/server.js' (line 27), the same line as test.sh 104-111. Results: runtime.json 15/15 true including cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing; persist-before.json 7/7 true; restart.log '{"restart":{"pid_before":"37","pid_after":"66"}}' followed by persist-after.json 'cw_save_reload_restart: true', i.e. the record survived a real process replacement on DB_PATH; pageErrors empty in every suite. I inspected the image the run used (cw-editor-agent-r3, created 2026-10-01T22:19Z, after the last Dockerfile commit of 2026-09-29): Node v22.23.2, express 5.1.0, better-sqlite3 12.4.1, NODE_PATH set, matching environment/Dockerfile.

Adversarial checks tried. (a) Weak-reference shape that would pass a source read but fail at run time: a server resolving 'public' from process.cwd() or opening the database before listen with a relative path; neither is present. (b) Conforming alternative: the template's two-line solve.sh; the task's longer version keeps the same destination and adds only a database reset, so it is not a contract departure.

Residual observations, none rising to a defect for this row: (1) The scripted run was in the agent image, not through tests/test.sh inside the separate verifier image, and the /tmp/submission fallback branch (test.sh lines 99-102) was not exercised; server.js is location-independent by source reading, and the verifier-image launch belongs to the separate runtime record and row 22. The hosted run in observation 2 is on an earlier candidate and is not used as a measurement here. (2) solve.sh's open-database guard (lines 9-36) treats only ENOENT/ESRCH as ignorable, so on a re-install as a non-root user with an existing /app/app.db an EACCES on another user's /proc/<pid>/fd would abort the install; this path is skipped entirely on a first install ('if (databases.length)') and the oracle runs solve.sh once as root in a fresh container, so it does not affect the stated contract. (3) server.js also accepts an undocumented SQLITE_PATH fallback; it is unset under env -i and harmless. (4) cp -a also copies src/, package.json, package-lock.json and vite.config.mjs into /app; unused at run time and harmless.
